items.name: Shelter Locker Unit

Its reinforced alloy frame is designed to withstand the harsh vibrations of society expansion, while the internal pressure-seal ensures that delicate electronics and personal mementos remain protected from the planet's fine silicate dust. A reliable staple for any growing settlement, ensuring that even in the most remote outposts, a Seedling's belongings have a safe home.

items.name: Shelter Locker Units Set
items.description: The primary gear-management solution for high-density frontier outposts. This four-bay configuration provides a centralized storage hub for your squad, combining individual security with rugged, space-saving architecture. Each compartment is reinforced with a pressure-sealed alloy door and a biometric sensor, protecting vital tools and personal items from the unpredictable elements of Avesta. Whether installed in a central habitat or a remote mining station, the Shelter Locker Set ensures your team stays organized and their equipment stays mission-ready.
